notes: Spec demands 'Use Backtrader resampledata to create 4H and 1D from a 60-minute base feed', but the bench wrapper (tape_exec.py replicating their harness) adds exactly one PandasData feed and instantiates the strategy inside cerebro.run(), so resampledata is impossible and implementers must invent manual 4H/1D aggregation from 7 irregular hourly bars per session (9:30-15:30) -- boundary choices alone diverge tapes. The 'score in [-10, +10]' contradicts its own definition as a sum of 15 +/-1 signals (clamp vs rescale changes whether thresholds >=+2/+3 fire). 'Stochastic(14)' pins one of three backtrader params, 'slope(5)' for OBV/AccumDist/VPT is undefined, and the Supertrend/order-block-proxy constructions leave switching/zone rules loose (unpinned-indicator-params, unpinned-entry-trigger). 'Optional trailing stop: after trade moves +1*ATR...' is explicitly optional, so exit behavior is unpinned. No hardcoded prices; prose asset AAPL matches bound AAPL_1h.pkl (5082 rows, 2023-08-11 to 2026-07-10), enough for daily SMA200 warm-up.
